left.raw_text: Rest pain or tissue loss due to PAD (Fontaine stage III and IV)
acute lower extremity ischemic event secondary to thromboembolic disease
Walking capacity significantly limited by conditions other than claudication including leg (joint/musculoskeletal, neurologic) and systemic (heart, lung disease) pathology
Current use of either ACE inhibitors
Chronic kidney disease with estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate < 30 ml/min/1.73 m2
History of bilateral severe renal artery stenosis

right.raw_text: and 7) History of angioedema related to previous ACE-inhibitor treatment or known hypersensitivity to ramipril or other ACE inhibitors.
